scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:portfolio: npm install --prefix client && npm run build:portfolio --prefix client
scripts.deploy: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run db:generate --prefix server && npm run build
scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run start --prefix server
